cards.name: ScreenInfo
cards.path: Printing classes for Adobe Illustrator/ScreenInfo
cards.summary: Halftone screen settings for one colour-separation screen a PostScript printer's PPD offers: line frequency (lpi), screen angle in degrees and whether it is the printer's default. It is information for choosing print output, it does not change any artwork.
use_for: checking which halftone rulings (lpi / angle) a PostScript printer supports before a scripted separation print
preflight report of a press PPD's default screen
avoid: a visible halftone dot look in the artwork: screens act only at PostScript output; use a halftone effect on the art instead
cards.how: Reached through the PPD list: app.getPPDFileInfo(app.PPDFileList[i].name).screenList[j] is a Screen (name + screenInfo); screenInfo is this value object. COM: _ScreenInfo / ScreenInfo (DefaultScreen, Frequency, Angle).

key_members.name: frequency
key_members.use: screen ruling in lines per inch

key_members.name: defaultScreen
key_members.use: true for the PPD's default screen

gotchas: Only PostScript printers with a PPD have screens; the list is empty for other drivers (unverified)
Editing frequency / angle here does not change a print job; the per-ink screen used for output is InkInfo.frequency / angle in PrintOptions.colorSeparationOptions.inkList (unverified)

app.PPDFileList entries hold only the PPD model name and file spec (harvest: trimmed for performance), so PPDFileList[i].PPDInfo is not the detailed info and may lack the screen lists; call app.getPPDFileInfo(name) for the full PPDFileInfo

review.changes: how/example now reach the screen list through app.getPPDFileInfo(name): the harvest says PPDFileList entries hold only name + file spec, so PPDFileList[0].PPDInfo.screenList was the wrong route; replaced the gotcha that misread that note as 'slow first read'; dropped CDR SeparationPlate (per-plate output setting = AI InkInfo, not a PPD's available screen)

cards.name: ScreenSpotFunction
cards.path: Printing classes for Adobe Illustrator/ScreenSpotFunction
cards.summary: One halftone dot shape (spot function) defined in a PostScript printer's PPD: a name plus the PostScript code that draws the dot (round, elliptical, line ...). Used when choosing dot shape for separations; it does not touch artwork.
use_for: listing the dot shapes a press PPD supports before a scripted separation print
documenting output settings for a print vendor
avoid: a visible halftone pattern in the design: spot functions only act at PostScript output time
cards.how: app.getPPDFileInfo(app.PPDFileList[i].name).screenSpotFunctionList[j]; two string properties. COM: ScreenSpotFunction (Name, SpotFunction).

key_members.name: spotFunction
key_members.use: the PostScript procedure that defines the dot

gotchas: spotFunction is raw PostScript, meaningful only to a PostScript RIP; non-PostScript devices ignore it (unverified)
The dot shape actually used per ink is chosen on the print side (InkInfo.dotShape)
The list can be empty when the PPD defines no spot functions (unverified)

app.PPDFileList entries hold only the PPD model name and file spec (harvest: trimmed for performance), so PPDFileList[i].PPDInfo is not the detailed info and may lack the screen lists; call app.getPPDFileInfo(name) for the full PPDFileInfo

review.changes: how/example use app.getPPDFileInfo(name) instead of PPDFileList[0].PPDInfo (PPDFileList entries are name + file spec only); added that gotcha; InkInfo.dotShape is in the harvest so dropped its (unverified)

cards.name: Artboard
cards.path: Scripting commands and classes for Adobe Illustrator/Artboard
cards.summary: One artboard (page) of an Illustrator document: its rectangle on the canvas, name, ruler origin and the video centre / cross-hair / safe-area marks. Scripts read it to place or export art per page and edit it to resize or rename pages.
use_for: resizing an artboard to a social format (1080 x 1350 post, 1080 x 1920 story)
naming artboards before Export for Screens or per-artboard PDF / PNG export
placing art relative to a given artboard's bounds
multi-size campaign files with one artboard per size
avoid: expecting the art to follow: changing artboardRect moves only the page, translate the page items too
deleting the last artboard: a document must keep at least one (unverified)
cards.how: doc.artboards[i]; the Artboards collection has add(rect), insert(rect, index), remove(index), getByName, getActiveArtboardIndex / setActiveArtboardIndex. COM: Document.Artboards(i) -> Artboard.

key_members.name: artboardRect
key_members.use: [left, top, right, bottom] in points; set it to move or resize the page

key_members.name: name
key_members.use: artboard name used by exports and the Artboards panel

key_members.name: rulerOrigin
key_members.use: ruler origin, relative to the artboard's bottom-left corner

key_members.name: rulerPAR
key_members.use: pixel aspect ratio for pixel rulers

key_members.name: showSafeAreas
key_members.use: show video title / action safe areas

key_members.name: canChangeRulerCoordinateSystem
key_members.use: can the ruler coordinate system be changed

gotchas: artboardRect is [left, top, right, bottom] in points with the y axis pointing up, so top is greater than bottom
Values depend on app.coordinateSystem (DOCUMENTCOORDINATESYSTEM vs ARTBOARDCOORDINATESYSTEM); read and write in the same one
Artboard has no index member: find an artboard's index by looping doc.artboards or via getActiveArtboardIndex()
A rect outside the canvas limits throws (unverified)

cards.name: ArtStyle
cards.path: Scripting commands and classes for Adobe Illustrator/ArtStyle
cards.summary: A graphic style from the Graphic Styles panel: a saved appearance (fills, strokes, effects, opacity) applied to objects in one go. Scripts can find it by name, apply or merge it, rename or delete it, but cannot read or build its appearance.
use_for: applying a saved brand look (neon stroke, shadowed badge, sticker outline) to many objects at once
styling generated shapes or text consistently in template scripts
adding a style's attributes on top of existing appearance with mergeTo
avoid: building a style from scratch: ArtStyle exposes no fills or effects; set them on the object (fillColor, applyEffect) or bring the style in from a template document
keeping the object's own appearance: applyTo replaces it, use mergeTo
cards.how: doc.graphicStyles (ArtStyles: getByName, removeAll); style.applyTo(item) or style.mergeTo(item). COM names it GraphicStyle / Document.GraphicStyles.

key_members.name: applyTo
key_members.use: replace an object's appearance with this style

key_members.name: mergeTo
key_members.use: merge this style into the object's current appearance

key_members.name: name
key_members.use: style name as shown in the panel

key_members.name: remove
key_members.use: delete the style from the document

gotchas: There is no ArtStyles.add: a script cannot create a graphic style, only use ones already in the document
doc.graphicStyles[0] is normally [Default]; applying it strips the appearance (unverified)
applyTo replaces fills, strokes and effects; mergeTo layers the style's attributes on top
ExtendScript calls the class ArtStyle while COM calls it GraphicStyle

cards.name: Brush
cards.path: Scripting commands and classes for Adobe Illustrator/Brush
cards.summary: A brush from the document's Brushes panel (calligraphic, scatter, art, pattern or bristle). A script can find it by name and stroke paths with it via applyTo; the brush definition itself is not readable or editable.
use_for: giving generated paths a hand-drawn or art-brush stroke
applying a brand pattern brush (border, stitch, rope) to frames
re-stroking many lines with one chosen brush
avoid: changing brush size or shape: Brush has only a name; edit it in the Brushes panel or load another brush
heavy bristle brushes on many paths: slow redraw and export, flatten or use an art brush
cards.how: doc.brushes (Brushes: getByName, add(brushDefinition File, brushName), addAndLoad(File)); brush.applyTo(pathItem). COM: Document.Brushes -> Brush.

key_members.name: applyTo
key_members.use: stroke the given object(s) with this brush

gotchas: Brush has no remove member in this harvest; delete brushes in the panel or with an action
Brushes.add / addAndLoad take a brush definition file; the accepted file type is not stated in the harvest (unverified)
applyTo on objects that cannot take a brush (text frames, images) fails or does nothing (unverified)
Brushes from libraries must be in the document's panel before getByName finds them (unverified)

cards.name: CompoundPathItem
cards.path: Scripting commands and classes for Adobe Illustrator/CompoundPathItem
cards.summary: A compound path: several paths combined into one object so overlaps cut holes (letter counters, rings, cut-out logos). It has one fill and stroke shared by its member paths and acts as a single shape.
use_for: logos and icons with holes (rings, letters, cut-outs)
knock-out text shapes after outlining type
one clipping mask built from several shapes
avoid: parts that need different colours: a compound has one fill, use a group
permanently merging shapes: use Pathfinder (Unite / Minus Front)
cards.how: doc.compoundPathItems / layer.compoundPathItems / group.compoundPathItems (CompoundPathItems: add, getByName). Create it, then draw into compound.pathItems (rectangle, ellipse ...). Inherits PageItem (position, bounds, opacity, resize). COM: CompoundPathItem.

key_members.name: pathItems
key_members.use: the member paths; create new paths inside the compound through it

key_members.name: move
key_members.use: move it to another container / z position

gotchas: No fillColor / strokeColor on the compound itself: set them on compound.pathItems[0] and the shared paint applies to all members
A compound made from outlined text or groups can contain groups, then pathItems.length is 0 and the colour trick fails (unverified)
Whether an inner path cuts a hole depends on path direction and the fill rule; draw the inner shape reversed or set evenodd (unverified)
PageItem members (position, width, rotate ...) work but are not listed in this class's own members

cards.name: Dimensions
cards.path: Scripting commands and classes for Adobe Illustrator/Dimensions
cards.summary: A plain width / height pair. In this harvest it is the type of ExportOptionsPNG24.dimensions, the box an exported PNG must fit into; its units are not stated in the harvest.
use_for: exporting a PNG to a fixed box (for example a 1080 x 1080 social tile)
thumbnail exports at an exact size
avoid: sizing artwork or artboards: use PageItem width / height or Artboard.artboardRect
cards.how: Value object read from or assigned to ExportOptionsPNG24.dimensions, then the options go to doc.exportFile(file, ExportType.PNG24, options). COM: Dimensions (Width, Height).
gotchas: Units (pixels or points) are not stated in the harvest; test an export before relying on it (unverified)
How it interacts with horizontalScale / verticalScale on the same options object is undocumented (unverified)
Whether new Dimensions() can be constructed is not confirmed; reading opts.dimensions, editing and assigning back is safer (unverified)

cards.name: DocumentPreset
cards.path: Scripting commands and classes for Adobe Illustrator/DocumentPreset
cards.summary: The settings for a new document: title, size, artboard count and layout, colour mode, units, raster-effects resolution, preview mode, transparency grid and bleed. Passed to Documents.addDocument to create a file without the New Document dialog.
use_for: creating print-ready CMYK documents with bleed from a script
spinning up multi-artboard campaign files (N artboards in a grid or row)
standardising new files to house units and effect resolution
avoid: changing an existing document: the preset only applies at creation; edit doc.artboards or doc.rasterEffectSettings instead
cards.how: new DocumentPreset(), or app.getPresetSettings(name) to start from a profile in app.startupPresetsList; then app.documents.addDocument(startupPreset, presetSettings, showOptionsDialog). COM: DocumentPreset for Documents.AddDocument.

key_members.name: artboardRowsOrCols
key_members.use: rows or columns for grid layouts

gotchas: Sizes are in points whatever units says; units only sets the rulers (unverified)
numArtboards is limited to 1-100 and artboardRowsOrCols to 1..numArtboards-1 (harvest descriptions)
startupPreset must be a name from app.startupPresetsList; an unknown name throws (unverified)
The order of the four documentBleedOffset values is not stated in the harvest (unverified)

cards.name: EmbedItem
cards.path: Scripting commands and classes for Adobe Illustrator/EmbedItem
cards.summary: An item in doc.embeddedItems: placed content stored inside the .ai rather than linked. The harvest gives it only a file property plus move / duplicate / remove; which kinds of embedded art Illustrator 30.2 reports here (versus RasterItem) is not documented.
use_for: auditing embedded content before packaging or handing off a file
reading the source file recorded for embedded art
avoid: placing new linked art: use PlacedItems.add() and set file
pixel edits: embedded bitmaps are RasterItem objects
cards.how: doc.embeddedItems (EmbeddedItems: add, getByName, removeAll); inherits PageItem. COM: EmbedItem.

key_members.name: file
key_members.use: the file the embedded art came from

gotchas: What EmbeddedItems.add() creates and how to fill it is undocumented; placedItems.add() + file + embed() is the known route (unverified)
Embedded bitmaps usually show up as RasterItem; scan doc.rasterItems as well (unverified)
file can point to a path that no longer exists once the art is embedded (unverified)

cards.name: Gradient
cards.path: Scripting commands and classes for Adobe Illustrator/Gradient
cards.summary: A gradient swatch definition: linear or radial type, a name and its colour stops. Applied to art through a GradientColor fill or stroke it gives smooth colour blends such as sky backgrounds, metallic buttons or glows.
use_for: background blends for posters and social tiles
brand gradient swatches created by script
metallic or glossy button fills
radial spotlight / vignette fills
avoid: freeform (point / line) gradients: only LINEAR and RADIAL exist in GradientType
colour that follows a shape's contours: use a gradient mesh or Object > Blend
cards.how: doc.gradients.add() (Gradients: add, getByName); set type, edit gradientStops, then var gc = new GradientColor(); gc.gradient = g; item.fillColor = gc. COM: Document.Gradients -> Gradient.

key_members.name: gradientStops
key_members.use: the colour stops; add more with gradientStops.add()

gotchas: Angle, origin and length belong to the GradientColor applied to the object, not to the Gradient
A new gradient starts with two stops (unverified)
Editing a gradient swatch changes every object that uses it
Freeform gradients cannot be created through GradientType

cards.name: GradientStop
cards.path: Scripting commands and classes for Adobe Illustrator/GradientStop
cards.summary: One colour stop of a gradient: its colour, position on the ramp (rampPoint, percent), midpoint to the next stop (midPoint, percent) and opacity. Stops decide which colours a gradient blends and where.
use_for: setting brand colours on a gradient swatch
fade-to-transparent overlays (stop opacity 0)
multi-colour gradient ramps for backgrounds
avoid: changing gradient direction or angle: that is on GradientColor, not on stops
cards.how: gradient.gradientStops[i]; new stops with gradient.gradientStops.add(). COM: GradientStop.

key_members.name: rampPoint
key_members.use: position along the gradient in percent

key_members.name: midPoint
key_members.use: midpoint toward the next stop in percent

gotchas: opacity, rampPoint and midPoint are percentages (0-100), not 0-1
midPoint is limited to 13-87 and rampPoint / opacity to 0-100 (ranges from the COM type library descriptions)
A gradient keeps at least two stops; removing below that fails (unverified)
A stop colour that does not match the document colour mode is converted (unverified)

review.changes: midPoint 13-87 gotcha now cites the batch's COM description (MidPoint 13.0-87.0) instead of outside docs, no longer unverified; added rampPoint 0-100 range from the same source

cards.name: GraphItem
cards.path: Scripting commands and classes for Adobe Illustrator/GraphItem
cards.summary: A chart made with Illustrator's Graph tools (column, bar, line, pie ...). Scripting can only move, duplicate or remove it and bind it to a graph variable for data-driven graphics; chart type and data are not reachable from the DOM.
use_for: data-driven infographics through Variables (bind the graph, then apply data sets)
finding and repositioning charts in templates
avoid: building charts by script: GraphItems has no add; draw bars and wedges with PathItems instead
modern-looking charts without restyling: Illustrator graphs need manual styling
cards.how: doc.graphItems / layer.graphItems / group.graphItems (GraphItems: getByName, removeAll); contentVariable takes a Variable from doc.variables. COM: GraphItem.

key_members.name: contentVariable
key_members.use: bind the graph to a GRAPH-kind variable

gotchas: No way to create a graph or read its data from script
The bound variable should be of kind VariableKind.GRAPH (unverified)
Ungrouping a graph turns it into ordinary art; it is then no longer a GraphItem

cards.name: GroupItem
cards.path: Scripting commands and classes for Adobe Illustrator/GroupItem
cards.summary: A group of page items handled as one object; with clipped = true the top-most path clips the rest (a clipping mask). The main container for compositions such as badges, lockups and masked photos.
use_for: logo lockups and badges moved and scaled as one
clipping a photo or pattern into a shape
building layout blocks by drawing straight into the group
importing a file as editable art via createFromFile
avoid: holes inside one shape: use a CompoundPathItem
organising a whole document: use Layers
cards.how: doc.groupItems.add() (GroupItems: add, createFromFile, getByName), also layer.groupItems / group.groupItems. Typed child collections (pathItems, textFrames, placedItems ...) create art inside the group; pageItems lists all children. Inherits PageItem. COM: GroupItem.

key_members.name: clipped
key_members.use: true = top-most path clips the group (clipping mask)

key_members.name: pathItems
key_members.use: child paths; draw new paths into the group

gotchas: clipped = true needs a path or compound path as the top-most child to act as the clip; mark it clipping = true
pageItems[0] is the front-most child, so creation order is reversed
Moving existing art into a group uses move(group, ElementPlacement.PLACEATEND); the omv harvest only lists the COM enum AiElementPlacement (aiPlaceAtEnd) (unverified)
Effects and opacity set on the group act on the group as a whole

cards.name: Layer
cards.path: Scripting commands and classes for Adobe Illustrator/Layer
cards.summary: A layer or sub-layer in the Layers panel: a named container for artwork with visibility, lock, print, preview, opacity and blend-mode settings. Scripts use layers to organise generated art and toggle template parts.
use_for: separating background, artwork, text and guides in generated files
template variants: show or hide layers before each export
non-printing notes or dielines (printable = false)
locking finished layers so later steps cannot move them
avoid: moving a few objects together: use a GroupItem
adding art to a locked or hidden layer: unlock and show it first
cards.how: doc.layers / layer.layers (Layers: add, getByName, removeAll), doc.activeLayer, item.layer. Typed art collections on the layer (pathItems, textFrames, groupItems ...) create art directly in it. COM: Document.Layers(i) -> Layer.

key_members.name: printable
key_members.use: include in print and PDF output

key_members.name: hasSelectedArtwork
key_members.use: true selects all art on the layer, false deselects it

key_members.name: pathItems
key_members.use: paths; draw new shapes onto this layer

key_members.name: remove
key_members.use: delete the layer and its art

gotchas: Creating or moving art into a locked or hidden layer throws; set locked = false and visible = true first
layers.add() puts the new layer on top; reorder with zOrder(ZOrderMethod.SENDTOBACK)
color is the panel highlight colour, not a fill
A document needs at least one layer; removing the last fails (unverified)

cards.name: LegacyTextItem
cards.path: Scripting commands and classes for Adobe Illustrator/LegacyTextItem
cards.summary: Unconverted text from documents saved before Illustrator 11 (the pre-CS text engine). It displays but cannot be edited until converted; convertToNative turns it into modern text inside a group and deletes the legacy item.
use_for: batch-updating old Illustrator files so their type becomes editable
auditing archive files for legacy text before reuse
avoid: files where legacy line breaks and spacing must stay exact: conversion can reflow text, check or keep an outlined copy
cards.how: doc.legacyTextItems / layer.legacyTextItems (LegacyTextItems: getByName, convertToNative); item.convertToNative() returns a GroupItem. COM: LegacyTextItem.

key_members.name: converted
key_members.use: has this item already been updated (read-only)

key_members.name: convertToNative
key_members.use: create native text (returns a GroupItem) and delete the legacy item

gotchas: convertToNative deletes the original; use the returned GroupItem, not the old reference
Converted text can reflow (spacing, kerning, line breaks) (unverified)
Loop backwards while converting, the collection shrinks as items are converted

cards.name: ListStyle
cards.path: Scripting commands and classes for Adobe Illustrator/ListStyle
cards.summary: A bullet / numbering list style of the document: per-level alignment, left and first-line indents, plus the prefix, postfix and bullet each level uses. Applied to paragraphs through ParagraphAttributes.listStyle.
use_for: consistent bulleted feature lists on posters, menus and spec sheets
numbered steps in infographics
hanging indents for list levels set by script
avoid: typing bullet characters into the text: they break on reflow, use a list style
defining the bullet or number format by script: only getters exist for prefix, postfix and bullet
cards.how: doc.listStyles (ListStyles: add(name), getByName); textRange.paragraphAttributes.listStyle = style (listStyleTier picks the level). put* methods return the ListStyle so calls chain. COM: ListStyle.

key_members.name: putFirstLineIndent
key_members.use: set a level's first-line indent (negative = hanging)

key_members.name: getSequencePrefix
key_members.use: text before the number of a level

key_members.name: getSequencePostfix
key_members.use: text after the number of a level

gotchas: index is the list level; whether it starts at 0 or 1 is not stated in the harvest (unverified)
alignment is a bare Int32, not an enum; its value mapping is undocumented (unverified)
No setters for prefix, postfix or bullet: make those in the UI and duplicate the style
List styles are new to the DOM; scripts using them fail on older Illustrator (unverified)

review.changes: 'new to the DOM / fails on older versions' is not in the batch, marked unverified

cards.name: MeshItem
cards.path: Scripting commands and classes for Adobe Illustrator/MeshItem
cards.summary: A gradient mesh object (Mesh tool / Create Gradient Mesh): a shape whose colour is painted across a grid of mesh points for photo-real shading. The DOM exposes no mesh points or colours, only move, duplicate and remove.
use_for: finding and repositioning mesh-shaded illustrations in templates
auditing heavy mesh objects before export
avoid: creating or editing mesh shading by script: not exposed; use gradients or blur effects for scripted shading
cards.how: doc.meshItems / layer.meshItems / group.meshItems (MeshItems: getByName, removeAll). Inherits PageItem. COM: MeshItem.
gotchas: MeshItems has no add: scripts cannot create meshes
Mesh point colours are not readable; recolour through menu commands such as Edit Colors (unverified)
Meshes can rasterise or bloat SVG / older-PDF exports (unverified)

cards.name: NonNativeItem
cards.path: Scripting commands and classes for Adobe Illustrator/NonNativeItem
cards.summary: Artwork Illustrator lists as non-native: objects it holds but does not model with its own art types. The harvest gives no members beyond move / duplicate / remove, and which objects fall in this class in 30.2 is not documented.
use_for: auditing documents for objects scripts cannot edit
moving or deleting such objects during cleanup
avoid: editing its content: no properties are exposed
cards.how: doc.nonNativeItems / layer.nonNativeItems / group.nonNativeItems (NonNativeItems: getByName). Inherits PageItem. COM: NonNativeItem.
gotchas: The NonNativeItems collection has no add or removeAll here; delete items one by one with remove()
Which artwork lands in this class (3D, plug-in or foreign art) is undocumented (unverified)

cards.name: PageItem
cards.path: Scripting commands and classes for Adobe Illustrator/PageItem
cards.summary: The base class of all artwork (paths, groups, text frames, placed and raster images, symbols, meshes ...). It carries the shared position, size, bounds, opacity, blend mode, lock / hide / select state and the transform, z-order and live-effect methods.
use_for: positioning and sizing any art in layout scripts
batch scale, rotate and move of many objects
applying live effects by XML (drop shadow, blur) via applyEffect
naming and tagging art for pipelines
walking all art via doc.pageItems or doc.selection
avoid: type-specific edits (fill colour, text, file link): check typename and use the concrete class
cards.how: Never created directly: items come from doc.pageItems, layer.pageItems, group.pageItems or doc.selection, and every concrete art class inherits these members. Check item.typename ('PathItem', 'GroupItem', 'TextFrame' ...) first. No COM PageItem interface is in the harvest (batch com = none); COM Document.PageItems returns the concrete objects.

key_members.name: typename
key_members.use: concrete class name, check before type-specific calls

key_members.name: applyEffect
key_members.use: apply a live effect from its LiveEffect XML

gotchas: Units are always points (1/72 in) whatever the ruler units
The y axis points up: art below the artboard top has negative top / y; bounds are [left, top, right, bottom]
resize() takes percentages (100 = unchanged), not points
rotate() angles are counter-clockwise positive (unverified)
applyEffect needs the exact LiveEffect XML (see the ai_effect cards' scripting field); bad XML can fail silently (unverified)
Modifying locked items or art on locked layers throws; the same for hidden items is unverified

review.changes: how claimed a COM PageItem; the batch has com = none and the harvest has no such interface, corrected; hidden-item throw marked unverified

cards.name: PathItem
cards.path: Scripting commands and classes for Adobe Illustrator/PathItem
cards.summary: A vector path (open or closed bezier) with its own fill, stroke, dash, cap, join and clipping / guide flags: the basic drawing object for shapes, lines and frames.
use_for: drawing layout shapes (rectangles, rounded boxes, ellipses, stars via PathItems)
polylines and icons from coordinates with setEntirePath
dashed borders, dividers and dielines
clipping masks and guides
measuring shape area and path length
avoid: shapes with holes: combine paths in a CompoundPathItem
text: use a text frame
cards.how: doc.pathItems / layer.pathItems / group.pathItems (PathItems: add, rectangle, roundedRectangle, ellipse, polygon, star, getByName). Points via pathPoints or setEntirePath([[x, y], ...]). Inherits PageItem. COM: PathItem.

key_members.name: setEntirePath
key_members.use: replace the path from an array of [x, y] pairs

key_members.name: setSmootheningPercentageValue
key_members.use: smooth the path by a percentage

gotchas: fillColor / strokeColor only show when filled / stroked are true
strokeDashes is an array of lengths in points; an empty array means a solid line
setEntirePath makes corner points only; set leftDirection / rightDirection on pathPoints for curves
area can come back negative depending on path direction (unverified)
convertAnchorToCorner / convertAnchorToSmooth / setSmootheningPercentageValue are recent members missing from older versions (unverified)

review.changes: 'recent members' version claim is not in the batch, marked unverified

cards.name: PathPoint
cards.path: Scripting commands and classes for Adobe Illustrator/PathPoint
cards.summary: One anchor of a path with its two bezier handles (leftDirection in, rightDirection out), its smooth / corner type and selection state. Editing path points reshapes curves precisely.
use_for: drawing smooth curves and waves from computed coordinates
sharpening or smoothing specific corners
reading anchor positions for alignment or export to data
avoid: simple polylines: PathItem.setEntirePath is shorter
cards.how: path.pathPoints[i] (PathPoints: add, getByName); add() appends a point at the end of the path. COM: PathPoint.
gotchas: A new point's handles sit on its anchor; set leftDirection / rightDirection or the segments stay straight
Setting pointType = SMOOTH does not move the handles; place them collinear yourself (unverified)
Coordinates are points with y up (negative below the artboard top)
selected is a PathPointSelection enum (ANCHORPOINT, LEFTDIRECTION ...), not a boolean

cards.name: PlacedItem
cards.path: Scripting commands and classes for Adobe Illustrator/PlacedItem
cards.summary: A linked file placed in the document (image, PDF, AI, PSD ...): it keeps a link to the file on disk plus its transform matrix and original bounds, and can be relinked, embedded or Image-Traced.
use_for: placing product photos and logos into templates
swapping images in a template by relinking
embedding links before handing off a file
auto-tracing a placed raster into vectors (trace)
avoid: sending files with unembedded links: embed() first or package the links
pixel retouching: edit in Photoshop and relink
cards.how: doc.placedItems / layer.placedItems / group.placedItems (PlacedItems: add, getByName); var p = doc.placedItems.add(); p.file = new File(path). Inherits PageItem. COM: PlacedItem.

key_members.name: file
key_members.use: the linked file; set it right after add()

key_members.name: contentVariable
key_members.use: bind to an IMAGE variable for data-driven swaps

key_members.name: embed
key_members.use: embed the linked file in the document

key_members.name: relink
key_members.use: point the link to another file

key_members.name: trace
key_members.use: Image Trace with default options, returns a PluginItem

gotchas: Set file immediately after placedItems.add(); an empty PlacedItem is useless
After embed() the PlacedItem reference is dead (the art becomes a RasterItem or group); find the new item again (unverified)
For multi-page PDFs set app.preferences.PDFFileOptions.pageToOpen before placing to choose the page
trace() uses default tracing options; adjust through the returned PluginItem's tracing object

cards.name: PluginItem
cards.path: Scripting commands and classes for Adobe Illustrator/PluginItem
cards.summary: Art generated and owned by a plug-in, most often an Image Trace result (isTracing / tracing). The DOM exposes only the tracing link plus move, duplicate and remove.
use_for: finishing a scripted Image Trace: reach the TracingObject and expand it to paths
finding unexpanded trace objects before export
avoid: creating plug-in art directly: get a PluginItem from PlacedItem.trace() or RasterItem.trace()
cards.how: Returned by placedItem.trace() / rasterItem.trace(); also doc.pluginItems (PluginItems: getByName, removeAll). item.tracing -> TracingObject (tracingOptions, expandTracing, releaseTracing). COM: PluginItem.

key_members.name: isTracing
key_members.use: is this plug-in group an Image Trace (read-only)

gotchas: tracing is only meaningful when isTracing is true
Tracing may not be finished right after trace(); call app.redraw() before expandTracing() (unverified)
expandTracing() returns a GroupItem that replaces the plug-in art; use the returned group
Other plug-in art (blends, envelopes ...) may also appear as PluginItem with nothing editable (unverified)

cards.name: Preferences
cards.path: Scripting commands and classes for Adobe Illustrator/Preferences
cards.summary: Application-wide Illustrator preferences: typed get / set / remove of any preference key, plus the options used when opening or placing Photoshop, PDF and AutoCAD files.
use_for: choosing which PDF page to place or open
keeping PSD layers when opening or placing Photoshop files
flipping an app preference for a batch run and restoring it afterwards
avoid: per-document settings (units, raster effects): use Document properties
guessing keys: an unknown key just creates a new entry or returns a default (unverified)
cards.how: app.preferences (read-only property; its members are writable). Typed accessors get/set Boolean, Integer, Real and String preferences, preferenceExists, removePreference; open options via preferences.PDFFileOptions / photoshopFileOptions / AutoCADFileOptions. COM: Application.Preferences.

key_members.name: PDFFileOptions
key_members.use: OpenOptionsPDF used when opening / placing PDFs (pageToOpen ...)

key_members.name: preferenceExists
key_members.use: check a key before using it

gotchas: Keys are the internal names from the Illustrator Prefs file, not dialog labels; the harvest lists none, so check preferenceExists first
Reading with the wrong typed getter returns a default rather than an error (unverified)
Changes persist across sessions; restore old values at the end of a batch (unverified)
Some prefs only take effect after a restart (unverified)

review.changes: persistence and unknown-key behaviour are not in the batch, marked unverified

cards.name: RasterEffectOptions
cards.path: Scripting commands and classes for Adobe Illustrator/RasterEffectOptions
cards.summary: The document's Raster Effects Settings (Effect > Document Raster Effects Settings): resolution, colour model, transparent background, anti-aliasing, clipping mask, spot conversion and padding used whenever live raster effects (shadows, blurs, glows, Photoshop effects) render.
use_for: setting 300 ppi before print export so shadows and blurs are not soft
dropping to 72 ppi while building heavy web layouts for speed
rendering effects on a transparent background
avoid: rasterising objects permanently: use Document.rasterize with RasterizeOptions
cards.how: doc.rasterEffectSettings (read / write Document property); edit its fields and assign it back. COM: Document.RasterEffectSettings -> RasterEffectOptions.

key_members.name: padding
key_members.use: extra space around objects in points

gotchas: Assign the edited object back to doc.rasterEffectSettings; editing a fetched copy may not apply (unverified)
Pixel-based effects can change visible size when resolution changes (unverified)
High resolution with many effects slows redraw and export a lot

cards.name: RasterItem
cards.path: Scripting commands and classes for Adobe Illustrator/RasterItem
cards.summary: An embedded bitmap in the document (pasted, embedded or rasterised art): pixels with matrix, bounds, colour space, channels, bit depth and link status. Grayscale images can be colourised and any raster can be Image-Traced.
use_for: preflight of embedded images: colour space, bit depth, embedded flag
tinting grayscale images with a brand colour (colorize)
auto-tracing embedded bitmaps into vectors
avoid: pixel edits: open the image in Photoshop
linked images: those are PlacedItem
cards.how: doc.rasterItems / layer.rasterItems / group.rasterItems (RasterItems: getByName, removeAll); produced by placedItem.embed() or doc.rasterize(). Inherits PageItem. COM: RasterItem.

key_members.name: colorize
key_members.use: tint with a CMYK or RGB colour

gotchas: RasterItems has no add: make one by embedding a PlacedItem or with doc.rasterize()
colorize is meant for grayscale / bitmap images; on colour images it fails or does nothing (unverified)
There is no effective-ppi member; derive it from boundingBox and the placed size (unverified)
file is read-only and can be empty for pasted images (unverified)

cards.name: RasterizeOptions
cards.path: Scripting commands and classes for Adobe Illustrator/RasterizeOptions
cards.summary: The options for Document.rasterize: resolution, colour model, transparent or black background, anti-aliasing method, clipping mask, spot conversion, text-to-outlines, layer attributes and padding. Controls how vector art becomes an embedded bitmap.
use_for: flattening heavy vector art (blends, meshes, effects) into one image for a lighter file
making a pixel version of a logo or illustration for a mock-up
rasterising type with type-optimised anti-aliasing
avoid: keeping art editable: rasterize is destructive, duplicate first or use a live Rasterize effect
setting live-effect resolution: that is RasterEffectOptions
cards.how: var o = new RasterizeOptions(); set fields; doc.rasterize(sourceArt, clipBounds, o) returns the new raster art. COM: RasterizeOptions passed to Document.Rasterize.

key_members.name: backgroundBlack
key_members.use: rasterise against black instead of white

gotchas: doc.rasterize disposes the source art (harvest description); duplicate it first if you need the vectors
clipBounds is [left, top, right, bottom] in points; pass the item's visibleBounds to keep strokes
padding is in points, resolution in dpi
DEFAULTCOLORMODEL follows the document colour mode

cards.name: Symbol
cards.path: Scripting commands and classes for Adobe Illustrator/Symbol
cards.summary: A symbol definition in the Symbols panel: reusable master art whose instances (SymbolItem) all follow the master. Keeps repeated elements light and consistent.
use_for: repeated icons, bullets and logos across a layout
scatters of one element with a small file size
9-slice scalable UI elements (Symbols.addWith9SliceScaling)
avoid: one-off art: a plain group is simpler
copies that need individual edits: break the link on the instance
cards.how: doc.symbols (Symbols: add(sourceArt, registrationPoint), addWith9SliceScaling, getByName); place instances with doc.symbolItems.add(symbol). COM: Document.Symbols -> Symbol.
gotchas: symbols.add copies the source art into the definition; the source art stays on the page as ordinary art (unverified)
Removing a symbol that still has instances may fail or break the instances (unverified)
The master art cannot be edited through the DOM; rebuild the art and redefine (unverified)
registrationPoint takes a SymbolRegistrationPoint value such as SYMBOLCENTERPOINT

cards.name: SymbolItem
cards.path: Scripting commands and classes for Adobe Illustrator/SymbolItem
cards.summary: One placed instance of a symbol: lightweight art mirroring its master Symbol that can be transformed on its own, switched to another symbol, or broken into ordinary editable art.
use_for: placing many copies of an icon or logo programmatically
swapping instances to a new design (assign symbol)
breaking instances into editable art for final tweaks
avoid: per-instance recolouring or reshaping: break the link first
cards.how: doc.symbolItems.add(symbol) (SymbolItems: add, getByName), also on layers and groups. Inherits PageItem. COM: SymbolItem.

key_members.name: symbol
key_members.use: the master Symbol; assign another to swap

key_members.name: breakLink
key_members.use: turn the instance into ordinary art

gotchas: After breakLink the SymbolItem reference is no longer valid; find the resulting art again (unverified)
Swapping symbol keeps the instance transform, so sizes jump if the masters differ (unverified)
New instances land at a default position; set position afterwards (unverified)

review.changes: symbol-swap sizing and default-position claims are not in the batch, marked unverified

cards.name: TabStopInfo
cards.path: Scripting commands and classes for Adobe Illustrator/TabStopInfo
cards.summary: One tab stop of a paragraph: alignment (left, center, right, decimal), position in points, decimal character and leader string (for example dot leaders). Decides how tab characters line up columns of text.
use_for: price lists and menus with dot leaders
aligned columns in spec sheets inside one text frame
decimal-aligned numbers
avoid: real tables with cells: use separate text frames or a layout app
cards.how: textRange.paragraphAttributes.tabStops holds an array of TabStopInfo; build new ones with new TabStopInfo() and assign the array back (unverified). COM: TabStopInfo.

key_members.name: decimalCharacter
key_members.use: character to align on for Decimal stops

gotchas: tabStops is an array value: build or copy it and assign the whole array back; editing one element in place may not stick (unverified)
position is measured from the frame's left edge (unverified)
decimalCharacter only matters with TabStopAlignment.Decimal

cards.name: Tag
cards.path: Scripting commands and classes for Adobe Illustrator/Tag
cards.summary: A named string value attached to a page item (or document): invisible metadata stored in the file, used by scripts to mark objects and find them again later.
use_for: marking template slots (headline, photo, price) so a fill script can find them
recording a source id or version on generated art
round-trips between pipeline passes
avoid: visible labels: use the item name or note
large data: keep it in a sidecar JSON
cards.how: item.tags.add() (Tags: add, getByName, removeAll), then set name and value; doc.tags for document-level tags. COM: Tags on each art class (PathItem.Tags ...) and Document.Tags -> Tag.
gotchas: Tag names should be identifier-like; spaces or punctuation can throw (unverified)
value is always a string: serialise numbers or JSON yourself
Tags are invisible in the UI, so people editing the file can delete tagged art without noticing
tags.getByName throws when the tag is missing; wrap it in try / catch

review.changes: COM route named a non-existent PageItem interface; now PathItem.Tags / Document.Tags

cards.name: TextFont
cards.path: Scripting commands and classes for Adobe Illustrator/TextFont
cards.summary: An installed font as Illustrator sees it: name, family, style and, for variable fonts, the axis vector. Read-only; assigned to text through CharacterAttributes.textFont.
use_for: setting brand fonts on generated text
checking a font is installed before building a layout
listing families and styles for preflight
avoid: assuming a font exists: check TextFonts.isFontAvailable and fall back
cards.how: app.textFonts (TextFonts: getByName, getFontByName, isFontAvailable, getCurrentFont); textRange.characterAttributes.textFont = font. COM: Application.TextFonts -> TextFont.

key_members.name: name
key_members.use: the font's name used by getByName (read-only)

gotchas: getByName expects the internal (PostScript-style) name such as 'ArialMT', not the menu name; the harvest calls name the 'full name', so test the exact string (unverified)
getByName throws if the font is missing; use isFontAvailable or try / catch
All members are read-only
Looping app.textFonts is slow on machines with thousands of fonts; cache what you need
